clue.text: Vegetation by no means lush but free of pollution

definitions.meaning: stunted bushes and sparse growth on poor land
to clean thoroughly, as by rubbing hard

explanation.surface: Some sparse plant life is described as unlush but at least clean and unpolluted.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrub is low, stunted brushwood, and to scrub is to clean by hard rubbing; two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Pay, if sent, is specially handled for security reasons

definitions.note: a description of what the object is used for, fastening things securely

indicators.note: letters handled in a special way are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Wages, once dispatched, receive special handling for safety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is specially handled' rearranges the nine letters of PAY IF SENT. The definition is loose: the item is a clasp used to keep things secure.
explanation.definitionFit: This clasped pin has a guard over its point, so it fastens cloth securely without pricking.

clue.text: Making a comeback in a particular urban area of the country

indicators.note: coming back means the letters are taken from the end towards the start
the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood of a city is enjoying a revival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' picks LARUR from 'particuLAR URban'; 'Making a comeback' turns it round. 'area' merely completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Countryside life is the opposite of urban life; the adjective describes things belonging to farmland.

clue.text: One must be in the money before offering a woman support

definitions.note: a noun phrase for the garment that gives support

parts.note: brass is British slang for cash
I is the Roman numeral for one
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Someone must have cash first before they can help a lady out.
explanation.walkthrough: BRASS is everyday British slang for money; the pieces then run in order: BRASS, I, ERE.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra is an undergarment worn to support the bust.

clue.text: The outlook for groups taking in little money

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

indicators.note: one word swallows another, so the coin goes within the groups

parts.note: sects are religious or political groups
p is penny, a small coin

explanation.surface: Future chances for certain factions that accept small sums.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking in' is the container signal; 'little money' is the penny, abbreviated p in British coinage.
explanation.definitionFit: Prospects are expectations of what lies ahead, the view of the future.

clue.text: Artist given a bit of rope

definitions.meaning: someone who makes pictures with a brush
a line used to tie up a small boat at its bow

explanation.surface: A creative type is handed a short length of cord.
explanation.definitionFit: One who paints pictures, and a nautical mooring line attached to a dinghy's bow.

clue.text: Excel in public work

parts.note: overt means open, done in public
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone does outstanding work in the civic arena.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtop is to rise above or surpass, the same as to outdo.

clue.text: Dope to give an animal

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis, dope

explanation.surface: Drugging a creature with narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: A potto is a slow-moving West African primate, a kind of lemur-like creature.

clue.text: Contend if outcome is assured

indicators.note: the result of working the letters is a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Argue, and see whether the result is guaranteed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outcome' signals the letters of CONTEND IF are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Assured and self-reliant both mean sure of oneself, certain.

clue.text: Set about the French in unpleasant conditions

indicators.note: one word goes around another, enclosing it

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: Arrange to put the French in difficult circumstances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal; 'Set' looks like a verb but its own letters are the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Wet, icy precipitation makes for nasty weather conditions.

clue.text: Model of realism to give official recognition to

indicators.note: to model is to shape or mould, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: An example of realistic art being officially endorsed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' looks like a noun, but it reshapes the letters of OF REALISM.
explanation.definitionFit: To formalise is to make something official or give it a fixed, approved status.

clue.text: In need of tranquillisers in the past?

definitions.meaning: past is a grammatical form of a verb, as is present

explanation.surface: Asking whether someone once needed sedatives.
explanation.definitionFit: Nervous and keyed-up; also the grammatical form of a verb marking time, such as past.

clue.text: Covers for heels

definitions.meaning: canvas awnings over carts or boats
leans over, as a ship does

explanation.surface: Protective cases for shoe heels.
explanation.definitionFit: A tilt is an awning or canvas cover; to tilt is to lean, as a vessel heels.

clue.text: His clients have all got decorations

definitions.text: His clients have all got decorations

parts.words: His clients have all got decorations
parts.note: the decorations are inked designs on skin, not medals or tinsel

explanation.surface: A man whose customers have all been honoured with medals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decorations' suggests medals or honours; here they are images inked into the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone whose trade is marking skin with permanent designs has customers who wear those designs.

clue.text: A scientist beyond regret being retired

parts.note: past means beyond, as in walking past

indicators.note: retiring means going back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A researcher has got over feeling sorry about stopping work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being retired' signals a turnaround: retiring is drawing back.
explanation.definitionFit: Louis Pasteur was the French chemist who pioneered pasteurisation and vaccines.

clue.text: Dai's son, it may be, is so called

indicators.note: suggests a possible rearrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Dai's son, perhaps, has been given such a name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' rearranges DAI'S SON IT. Dai is a stock Welsh name.
explanation.definitionFit: A French borrowing meaning self-styled or supposed, describing a claimed title.

clue.text: Control vigilantes by craft

parts.note: a posse is a band gathered to enforce the law
SS is steamship, a vessel

explanation.surface: Keeping order with law-enforcers aboard a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To possess someone is to dominate or have power over them.

clue.text: Making a changeover that's really striking

definitions.meaning: changing from one thing to another
whipping, hitting with a thin cane

explanation.surface: A dramatic transformation is under way.
explanation.definitionFit: Exchanging one thing for another; also lashing with a flexible stick.

clue.text: Doesn't compete, yet scores

explanation.surface: Someone sits out the contest, but still gets the points.
explanation.definitionFit: Withdrawing an entry from a contest; and marks or grazes scraped on a surface.

clue.text: The simplicity seen in Eve at the Creation

indicators.note: creating makes something new, so the letters are made into a new order

explanation.surface: Innocence was visible in the first woman in Genesis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Creation' points to Genesis, but it rearranges IN EVE AT.
explanation.definitionFit: Naivety is innocence, lack of guile or worldly experience.

clue.text: A scholarly man recapitulates after a time

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first

parts.note: an era is a period of time
sums up: in a down clue SUMS read upwards

explanation.surface: A learned person repeats the summary some time later.
explanation.walkthrough: Recapitulates means SUMS UP; in a down clue 'up' writes SUMS bottom to top as SMUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Erasmus was the Dutch Renaissance humanist and classical scholar.

clue.text: After middle-age refuse to look flashy

indicators.note: the rubbish comes after the central letter
the centre letter of the word age

parts.note: litter is rubbish, refuse

explanation.surface: In middle years, someone declines to appear showy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle-age' looks like a life stage, but it gives the central letter of 'age', G.
explanation.definitionFit: To glitter is to sparkle brightly, to dazzle showily.

clue.text: The Greek consumer getting to be of more importance

parts.note: GR is an abbreviation for Greek
an eater consumes food

explanation.surface: A Greek shopper rises in significance.
explanation.definitionFit: Larger or more significant in degree, the comparative of big.

clue.text: Neat figure — fruit intake is responsible for it

parts.note: shape means figure, form
hips are the fruit of the rose

explanation.surface: A trim figure comes from what fruit someone eats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'intake' is the container signal; rose hips are the red fruit of the wild rose.
explanation.definitionFit: Shipshape means tidy and in good order.

clue.text: Quick trim

explanation.surface: A fast haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: Smart means brisk, as in a smart pace, and neatly dressed.

clue.text: Superior American rollers

explanation.surface: Excellent rolling waves seen in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: Americans say swell for fine or excellent; a swell is a heaving of long ocean waves.

clue.text: Turn up sports shirt, revealing a heavenly body

parts.note: to turn up is to arrive, come
a T-shirt, so the letter T

explanation.surface: Arriving in a sports top shows off one's fine physique.
explanation.definitionFit: A comet is an icy celestial object with a glowing tail.

clue.text: She will render many a solo

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, many
an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.surface: A woman will perform plenty of solo songs.
explanation.definitionFit: Maria is a woman's given name, so a female.

clue.text: Moderate rating at one point

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a naval rating
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Someone's grade at one stage is middling.
explanation.walkthrough: A rating is an ordinary sailor; AB is able-bodied seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: To abate is to lessen or reduce in intensity.

clue.text: A woman of authority with the right attitude backed in correspondence

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the word for correspondence

parts.note: a match is a correspondence, agreement

indicators.note: going back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: an air is a manner, attitude
R abbreviates right

explanation.surface: A powerful woman shows proper bearing in her letters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' signals a turnaround and 'in' a container; 'correspondence' suggests letters but means agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is the female head of a family or tribe.

clue.text: Gamblers of course use this automatically

definitions.text: Gamblers of course use this automatically

parts.words: Gamblers of course use this automatically
parts.note: on the racecourse, a machine records bets and works out payouts

explanation.surface: Gamblers naturally rely on this without thinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' seems to mean naturally; it means at the racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: A tote is the racecourse betting machine that pools stakes and calculates dividends.

clue.text: Note a girl may well be reflective

definitions.note: an adjective standing for a mirror or pane

parts.note: G is a musical note
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A notable girl may well be thoughtful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflective' seems to mean thoughtful; it means mirror-like.
explanation.definitionFit: A mirror is made of this transparent material, which reflects light.
